81:1.text: When the sun is wound round and its light is lost and is overthrown.

81:3.text: And when the mountains are made to pass away;

81:4.text: And when the pregnant she-camels are neglected;

81:5.text: And when the wild beasts are gathered together.

81:6.text: And when the seas become as blazing Fire or overflow.

81:7.text: And when the souls are joined with their bodies,
(the good with the good and the bad with the bad)

81:8.text: (as the pagan Arabs used to do)

81:9.text: For what sin, was she killed?

81:10.text: [of deeds (good and bad) of every person]

81:11.text: And when the heaven is stripped off and taken away from its place;

81:12.text: And when Hell-fire is set ablaze.

81:13.text: And when Paradise is brought near.

81:14.text: every person will know what he has brought

81:15.text: So verily, I swear by the planets that recede
(i.e. disappear during the day and appear during the night)

81:16.text: And by the planets that move swiftly and hide themselves.

81:17.text: And by the night as it departs.

81:18.text: And by the dawn as it brightens.

81:19.text: [Jibrîl (Gabrîl), from Allâh to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم]

81:24.text: withholds not a knowledge of the Unseen.

81:25.text: is not the word of the outcast Shaitân

81:27.text: is no less than a Reminder to

81:28.text: To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight.

81:29.text: that Allâh wills - the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn
